### 2026-10-06 – Worked on the schematic in KiCad today! Grounded one side of the push button to GND and connected the signal pin directly to D0 on the XIAO ESP32-C3 for active-LOW input. Also wired up the power and g

**1h**

Worked on the schematic in KiCad today! Grounded one side of the push button to GND and connected the signal pin directly to D0 on the XIAO ESP32-C3 for active-LOW input. Also wired up the power and ground paths across the component pins
